body.purpose: Simplified Chinese UI and status text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled action for translating or confirming a send.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--teal, #135f53); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--teal, #135f53); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--teal-hover, #0d4c42); background: var(--teal-hover, #0d4c42); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal, #135f53); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { background: var(--soft, #e4efe9); border-color: var(--rule, #b8cbc2); color: var(--muted, #455c53); cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined action for restoring, canceling, or managing the key.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #6f897d); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1b2825); font: 600 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--teal, #135f53); background: var(--teal-soft, #e7efe7); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal, #135f53); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { border-color: var(--rule, #b8cbc2); color: var(--muted, #455c53); cursor: default; }

components.name: API Key Field
components.description: Labeled password field for a user-supplied DeepSeek API Key.
components.html: <label class="ds-key">DeepSeek API Key<input type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="粘贴你的 API Key"></label>
components.css: .ds-key { display: block; color: var(--ink, #1b2825); font: 600 12px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key input { display: block; margin-top: 4px; min-height: 42px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #6f897d); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink, #1b2825); caret-color: var(--teal, #135f53); background: #fcfffd; font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #455c53); opacity: 1; } .ds-key input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal, #135f53); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Send Confirmation
components.description: Inline consent for sending the current page text to DeepSeek.
components.html:
确认发送正文

将当前页面可翻译的正文发送至 DeepSeek。该确认仅对当前页面有效。
components.css: .ds-consent { padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--soft, #e4efe9); color: var(--ink, #1b2825); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-consent h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-consent p { margin: 4px 0 12px; } .ds-consent-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-consent-actions button { flex: 1; min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--field-rule, #6f897d); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1b2825); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-consent-actions button:hover { border-color: var(--teal, #135f53); background: var(--teal-soft, #e7efe7); } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm { border-color: var(--teal, #135f53); background: var(--teal, #135f53); color: #fff; } .ds-consent-actions .ds-confirm:hover { border-color: var(--teal-hover, #0d4c42); background: var(--teal-hover, #0d4c42); } .ds-consent-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal, #135f53); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Settings Disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure with a visible key configuration state.
components.html:
DeepSeek 设置未配置

Key 保存在此浏览器。连接测试使用固定短文本。
components.css: .ds-settings { color: var(--ink, #1b2825); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-settings summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 0; font-weight: 600; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-settings summary::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: none; box-sizing: border-box; border: solid var(--teal, #135f53); border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform: rotate(-45deg); margin-inline-end: 2px; align-self: center; } .ds-settings[open] summary::before { transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-settings summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal, #135f53); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-key-state { margin-inline-start: auto; font-weight: 400; } .ds-key-state, .ds-settings p { color: var(--muted, #455c53); font-size: 12px; } .ds-settings p { margin: 6px 0 10px; }

components.name: GitHub Switch
components.description: Independent local interface translation setting for GitHub.
components.css: .ds-github { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 4px 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #b8cbc2); color: var(--ink, #1b2825); font: 14px/1.55 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-github strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-github small { display: block; color: var(--muted, #455c53); font-size: 12px; } .ds-github input { appearance: none; position: relative; width: 44px; height: 26px; margin: 0; background: var(--soft, #e4efe9); border: 1px solid var(--muted, #455c53); border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-github input::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px auto 3px 3px; width: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted, #455c53); } .ds-github input:checked { background: var(--teal, #135f53); border-color: var(--teal, #135f53); } .ds-github input:checked::before { transform: translateX(18px); background: #fff; } .ds-github input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal, #135f53); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-github input:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: default; }

narrative.overview: Yoread is a compact editorial utility for desktop Chrome. The serif wordmark and mineral greens establish the identity, while short status text and paired actions keep the current page in focus.
